name: brains
description: Your memory layer: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and prior Claude conversations as queryable pages, with reflexive recall, hook-driven turn-by-turn capture and inbox delivery, and boards/automations/workflows on top.

token.title: brains API token (optional)
token.description: Optional override. Conversation capture and the inbox follow your MCP sign-in — `claude mcp login plugin:brains:brains` — and need nothing set here. Use this only to capture into a different brains account, or to reach a self-hosted endpoint your sign-in does not cover. Find it in your brains account settings.

endpoint.title: brains endpoint
endpoint.description: Base URL of your brains server (no trailing slash). Conversation capture and the inbox derive /ingest/claude and /inbox/claude from it. The brains tools connect to https://mcp.mybrains.ai/mcp regardless of this setting.
